name: Inspiring
description:
Tries to avoid traps first and always rolls with dexterity. If successful, the trap is disarmed.
At the end of its turn, shields the ally with the lowest shield for 30 HP and INSPIRES them for 1 turns.
The amount shielded is affected by healing modifiers, and cannot exceed 20% max HP.

INSPIRED: this unit deals 25% more damage.
